description: F9 accept/reject vectors for CREATE UNIQUE INDEX in the hosted migration grammar (.github/scripts/production-migrations.mjs additiveSQL). Each `error` is a regular expression the refusal message must match. Ported repos run the same file against their own copy of the engine.
setup: CREATE TABLE app.t (id uuid NOT NULL, owner uuid, state text, generation bigint, active boolean, "odd;name" text, "user" text); CREATE TABLE app.x (id uuid NOT NULL, state text);

cases.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX t_id_key ON app.t (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX t_owner_state_key ON app.t (owner, state);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX t_live_key ON app.t (owner) WHERE state IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX t_active_key ON app.t (owner) WHERE state IS NOT NULL AND active = true
cases.why: partial: IS NOT NULL AND boolean

cases.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX t_running_key ON app.t (owner, generation) WHERE state = 'running' AND generation = 7 AND active = false
cases.why: partial: string, integer and boolean literals

cases.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX t_quote_key ON app.t (owner) WHERE state = 'it''s'
cases.why: doubled quote inside a string literal

cases.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "t_odd" ON "app"."t" ("odd;name") WHERE "odd;name" IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX t_user_key ON app.t ("user") WHERE "user" IS NOT NULL
cases.why: quoted reserved word is a column

cases.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX t_comment_key ON app.t (id) /* reviewed */ WHERE state IS NULL -- trailing
CREATE TABLE app.u (k text NOT NULL); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX u_k ON app.u (k); ALTER TABLE app.u ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
cases.why: unique index inside a multi-statement migration

cases.sql: CREATE INDEX t_plain ON app.t (owner, state)
cases.why: existing non-unique index form still accepted
CRLF line endings, including after a line comment
